reason: Seeing the cash drawer and who is in the chair while I am at my other work is exactly what I worry about, but I only have one or two chairs and I take home about ₹27,000 a month. ₹4,999 upfront and then ₹999 every month is too much for a shop this small, so I will keep my register and ask my one stylist to WhatsApp me the day's total.
objection: If the phone breaks or a stylist leaves with the phone, do I lose all my customer data? And after paying setup, if it doesn't work I can't get my ₹4,999 back.
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee, written proof that my data is safe online if the phone breaks, and about ₹499 a month for a one or two chair shop.
